title: Hypothetical: data-localisation requirement for cloud computing services

answers.name: Mandatory local storage and processing of all customer data
answers.description: Cloud and data-processing services may only be supplied using servers located in the territory; cross-border processing is prohibited.

notes.nt_lfv: Local infrastructure requirements weigh more heavily on foreign suppliers without domestic data centres.
notes.x_alternative: Transfer safeguards (adequacy decisions, contractual clauses, certification) could protect personal data with less trade restriction.
